audit.whatIsWrong: Content advises holding E Abscond to 'break her Supreme Display of Talent stun channel' — her R is an instant shockwave-detonation stun, not a channel, and a stunned Sylas cannot dash. Also misgendering across the full layer, template trade strings, pasted Do/Don't bodies, and no digits in cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit authority: R (120s) sends a shockwave that detonates elements and stuns — the counterplay is dashing clear before detonation and staying off terrain, not breaking the stun. E Audacity 11-7s, W Terrashape 7s, Royal Privilege front-loads the first hit.
audit.corrected: Stun-break claims replaced with dash-clear-before-detonation; pronouns fixed; cooldowns field now carries 11-7s, 7s and 120s; trades grounded in the Audacity-down window and the wall-stun threat.
